configuration.heading: Visitor guidance
configuration.body: All visitors must sign in at the main office and wear a visitor badge at all times. Please use the front entrance between 8 AM and 3 PM; the side doors stay locked during the school day. If you are picking up a student early, bring photo identification and allow ten minutes for the office to call the classroom. Thank you for helping us keep everyone safe.
